```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 10.0, 19.0),
    "L_in":    (0.9, 0.4, 1.5),
    "gmid_ld": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),
    "L_ld":    (0.9, 0.5, 1.5),
    "Itail":   (70e-6, 50e-6, 80e-6),
    "gmid_t":  (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),
    "L_t":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    It = p["Itail"]
    Ih = It / 2.0

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=0.8)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ih, vds=m3.vgs)

    # differential pair (NMOS)
    vtail_guess = vcm - 0.72
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=max(0.3, vdd - m3.vgs - vtail_guess))
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=max(0.3, vdd - m3.vgs - vtail), vsb=max(0.0, vtail))
    m2 = m1

    # tail and bias reference (same gm/Id and L -> ratio It/iref)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], It, vds=max(0.15, vtail))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mb.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diode side driven by vinp, output side by vinn -> vinp non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m2.gds + m4.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m2.cdd + m4.cdd + m4.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    fz = 2 * fp2
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
    slew = It / cout
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 4.6 * tau + 0.3 * 0.5 / slew
    power = 1.98 * (It + iref)
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (max(mt.gds, 1e-12) * (m2.gds + m4.gds)) * (m2.gds + m4.gds) / m3.gm)
    psrr = db(a0) + 3
    swing_hi = vdd - m4.vdsat - 0.1
    swing_lo = vcm - m2.vth + 0.05
    swing = swing_hi - swing_lo
    # noise estimate: thermal + rough area-based flicker term
    area = m1.W * m1.L
    noise = math.sqrt(2 * (8 * 1.38e-23 * 300 / (3 * gm1)) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)) \
        + 2.5e-6 / math.sqrt(max(area, 1e-3))

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "power": power,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr,
        "psrr_db": psrr,
        "swing": swing,
        "noise_1k": noise,
    }
```
